Description: Disposable, cost-bounded bulk_extractor large-image release validation.

Fn::Base64.Fn::Sub:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
exec > >(tee /var/log/bulk-extractor-release-validation.log | logger -t bulk-extractor-release-validation) 2>&1
wait_url='${ValidationWaitHandle}'
result_bucket='${ResultBucket}'
result_key='${AWS::StackName}/summary.txt'
scratch_volume_id='${ScratchVolume}'
max_runtime_minutes='${MaxRuntimeMinutes}'
source_url='${SourceArchiveUrl}'
source_sha256='${SourceArchiveSha256}'
input_bucket='${InputBucket}'
input_key='${InputKey}'
input_sha256='${InputSha256}'
signal_status=FAILURE
signal_reason=validation_failed
send_signal() { curl -fsS -X PUT -H 'Content-Type:' --data-binary "{\"Status\":\"$signal_status\",\"Reason\":\"$signal_reason\",\"UniqueId\":\"$HOSTNAME\",\"Data\":\"summary written\"}" "$wait_url"; }
finish() { send_signal || true; shutdown -h now; }
trap finish EXIT
dnf install -y awscli gcc gcc-c++ make autoconf automake libtool pkgconf-pkg-config expat-devel libgcrypt-devel openssl-devel re2-devel zlib-devel xfsprogs
systemd-run --unit=bulk-extractor-release-timeout --on-active=$max_runtime_minutes"m" /sbin/shutdown -h now
volume_serial=$(echo "$scratch_volume_id" | tr -d '-')
scratch_device=''
for attempt in $(seq 1 60); do
  for candidate in /dev/nvme*n1 /dev/xvd?; do
    [ -b "$candidate" ] || continue
    if lsblk -ndo SERIAL "$candidate" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '-' | grep -qx "$volume_serial"; then scratch_device="$candidate"; break; fi
  done
  [ -n "$scratch_device" ] && break
  sleep 10
done
[ -n "$scratch_device" ] || exit 1
blkid "$scratch_device" >/dev/null 2>&1 || mkfs.xfs -f "$scratch_device"
mkdir -p /mnt/bulk-extractor-release
mount "$scratch_device" /mnt/bulk-extractor-release
curl --fail --location --silent --show-error "$source_url" -o /tmp/source.tar.gz
echo "$source_sha256  /tmp/source.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /tmp/source.tar.gz -C /mnt/bulk-extractor-release
source_directory=$(find /mnt/bulk-extractor-release -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'bulk_extractor-*' -print -quit)
if RESULT_FILE=/tmp/summary.txt SCRATCH_DIRECTORY=/mnt/bulk-extractor-release SOURCE_DIRECTORY="$source_directory" INPUT_BUCKET="$input_bucket" INPUT_KEY="$input_key" INPUT_SHA256="$input_sha256" SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256="$source_sha256" MAX_RUNTIME_MINUTES="$max_runtime_minutes" "$source_directory/scripts/aws_large_image_worker.sh"; then worker_status=0; else worker_status=$?; fi
aws s3 cp /tmp/summary.txt "s3://$result_bucket/$result_key" --sse AES256 --only-show-errors || { signal_reason=summary_upload_failed; exit 1; }
if [ "$worker_status" -eq 0 ]; then signal_status=SUCCESS; signal_reason=validation_finished; fi
exit "$worker_status"

Properties.GroupDescription: No inbound access for bulk_extractor release validation

RuntimeCap.Value: 480 minutes; c6i.2xlarge compute is capped below the approximately $10 CPU budget.
